atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the `@tailwind` directive to insert Tailwind's `base`, `components`, `utilities` and `variants` styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use `@apply` to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: The `@screen` directive allows you to create media queries that reference your breakpoints by name instead of duplicating their values in your own CSS.

atDirectives.name: @variants
atDirectives.description: Generate `hover`, `focus` and other variants of your own utilities by wrapping their definitions in the `@variants` directive.

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: Generate responsive variants of your own utilities by wrapping their definitions in the `@responsive` directive.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Use the `@config` directive to specify which config file Tailwind should use when compiling that CSS file.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Use the `@theme` directive to define your project's custom design tokens, like fonts, colors, and breakpoints (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Use the `@source` directive to explicitly specify source files that aren't picked up by Tailwind's automatic content detection (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Use the `@utility` directive to add custom utilities to your project that work with variants like `hover`, `focus` and `lg` (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use the `@variant` directive to apply a Tailwind variant to styles in your CSS (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use the `@custom-variant` directive to add a custom variant to your project (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Use the `@plugin` directive to load a legacy JavaScript-based plugin (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Use the `@reference` directive to import your theme for use with `@apply` or `@variant` without duplicating any CSS output (Tailwind v4).
